name: Nakatani Remi
source:
A woman with great style and a little devilishness.

She is a troublemaker among the three. She is the one who destroys the plans made by the serious chairperson.

She is as strong and skilled in sexual relations as she appears to be. She is married to a rich older man, so she is interested in the young main character.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ047567.html/?locale=ja_JP]DLsite[/url]]
